Senate Bill 125 By: Senators Walker III of the 20th, Setzler of the 37th, Kennedy of the 18th, Strickland of the 42nd, Brass of the 6th and others AS PASSED SENATE
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Chapter 15 of Title 43 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to professional engineers and land surveyors, so as to decouple the sequential order of experience and … competent to practice professional engineering; and (C) Subsequently pass Pass a written examination in the principles and practice of engineering (professional engineer's examination)."
SECTION 2. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
